editorial:
Imagine finding out that everything you did to avoid a scary prediction actually made it come true. You follow Oedipus, a guy who thinks he has beat the odds. He left his home to make sure he never kills his dad or marries his mom, but he ends up becoming the king of Thebai and marrying the queen, Iocaste. The movie feels like a big, colorful stage play brought to life. It has a heavy mood, but the story is like a detective mystery where the main character is accidentally hunting himself. You can really feel the tension as the secrets start to leak out.

The acting is powerful and the costumes look amazing, though the slow pace might feel a bit heavy for some. The big twist hits hard because you see the clues right in front of you. If you like stories about fate and family secrets, you will love this. For the best experience, you should definitely try streaming it in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video to see all the detail in the sets. If you are a movie collector, adding the 4K Blu-ray to your physical collection is a great move because the visuals are just that stunning.
endingExplained: The big reveal is that the man Oedipus killed years ago was actually his real father, and the woman he married is his own mother. When Iocaste realizes the truth, she kills herself in grief. Oedipus is so broken and disgusted by what he did that he puts out his own eyes. He leaves the city as a blind wanderer, finally accepting that he could not run away from his destiny.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves Greek myths and intense family dramas.
